title: hermes-jailbench: a jailbreak regression benchmark for LLM endpoints
description: hermes-jailbench is a jailbreak regression benchmark that runs a repeatable battery of known-pattern attacks against an LLM endpoint and returns deterministic refusal/partial/compliance scores so teams can detect when a model or prompt change silently weakens established refusals. It uses a zero-LLM keyword scorer (no judge model in the hot path), supports a no-key dry-run and demo, and is positioned as a regression baseline for known patterns, not a novel-attack red-team. Built by Hermes Labs as part of its open-source AI reliability and assurance stack.
